title: Causal node/graph transition phase-lag field

target_design.cutoff_rule: For target index i, all field states, transition magnitudes and lag correlations are computed from draws[:i] only; the target draw is not read until ranking is frozen.

hypothesis: The magnitude of per-number node transitions may lead or lag changes in that number's pair-graph row. A causal rolling cross-correlation over the prior 80 field transitions may encode temporal phase information not captured by Q85 RMS acceleration or Q86 signed instantaneous cosine.

phase_definition.series: Per-number Euclidean magnitude of the 6-feature node velocity and Euclidean magnitude of the corresponding 40-edge graph-row velocity.
phase_definition.forward: mean of positive-lag correlations at lags 1,2,3
phase_definition.backward: mean of negative-lag correlations at lags 1,2,3

model_family: All eight Q86-DIR models plus four Q87 phase-lag candidates; 12 models total.
selection: Select one of the four Q87 candidates using Discovery mean Top20 hits only; tie-break lower mean actual rank then stable strategy ID. Freeze before Validation and historical Blind OOS.

statistics.exact_null: Discrete upper-tail convolution of Hypergeometric(40,k,5), with one global Holm family.
statistics.primary_gate: Selected historical Blind OOS Top20 lift >=0.10 versus Equal42, paired 95% CI lower bound >0, paired Holm p<0.05 and exact-null global Holm p<0.05.

safeguards: All phase correlations are computed from field transitions available before the target draw.
The current field state is included only after it has been computed from the target's strict prior prefix; the target outcome is read only after all rankings are frozen.
No phase window, lag, alpha, or operator is tuned on Validation or historical Blind OOS.
Historical Blind OOS has prior exposure and is exploratory, not prospective confirmation.
The lagged magnitude correlation is a statistical descriptor, not physical coupling or a literal fluid phase.
Rank vectors, all four per-number phase signals, target cutoffs and archive identity are replayed by a fail-closed validator.
No immutable freeze modification, shadow insertion, engine promotion, or automatic merge.
